India, US Troops Conduct Joint Military Exercise Yudh Abhyas

Indian and US troops are participating in the Yudh Abhyas military exercise, described as being in full swing by US Ambassador to India Gor. The exercise involves the exchange of expertise between the two armies and includes artillery drills with M777, Dhanush, and Pinaka systems.
